summary: full D4-vs-square advantage CURVE, measured by importance sampling (validated vs brute force at 1e-3, 0.0% diff) to logical error 1e-6. Advantage grows 0.5->0.7->1.2 dB as P_err 1e-1->1e-2->1e-6, tracking the union bound with kissing numbers and approaching the 1.5 dB coding gain only asymptotically -- STILL just ~1.2 dB at 1e-6. Honest spec is a curve not a number: ~0.7 dB near threshold, ~1.2 dB at 1e-6, full 1.5 dB only at far lower error. Single-shot lattice quantizer; full FT threshold needs surface-code decoder.
